title: Distributions of Mesh Patterns of Short Lengths on Separable Permutations
summary: This paper contributes to the long line of research on the distribution of mesh patterns in permutations. We extend these studies to separable permutations and carry out a comprehensive analysis of mesh patterns of length at most~2. For mesh patterns of length~1, we determine the distributions for all six equivalence classes. In addition, we obtain the joint distribution for the patterns in the class containing the well-known permutation statistic known as the strict fixed point.
